top_signals.title: Wärtsilä to Supply 34DF Engines for 12 New CMA CGM Container Vessels
top_signals.summary: Wärtsilä will supply a total of 36 Wärtsilä 34DF dual fuel engines for 12 new 18,000 TEU container vessels being built for French operator CMA CGM at the Jiangnan Shipyard in China. The vessels will run on LNG, supporting CMA CGM’s ambition to operate lower‑emission deep‑sea container ships.

top_signals.title: Google, Constellation Energy Strike Nuclear Power Deal
top_signals.summary: Google parent Alphabet Inc. agreed to buy nuclear power from Constellation Energy in a 20-year power-purchase agreement that will drive more than $4.3 billion in investments to upgrade systems at 11 Constellation reactors. Ed Ludlow has more on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)
